What is CACFP?

A Federal Program Built Around Feeding Children Well

The Child and Adult Care Food Program (CACFP) is a federal nutrition program administered in Texas by the Texas Department of Agriculture. It was created to ensure that children in licensed care settings receive balanced, nutritious meals every single day — and it supports the centers that make that possible.

  • Children receive balanced, nutritious meals that meet USDA standards
  • Your center receives monthly reimbursements to sustain the program
  • Free to join — no cost ever to your center
  • We handle compliance monitoring and TDA paperwork for you

The Process

How It Works — In 4 Simple Steps

Getting started with CACFP through Meals & More Support is straightforward. We guide you through every step.

1

Apply Online

Fill out our simple contact form. We will reach out within one business day to review your center's eligibility and answer your questions.

2

Get Approved

We submit your application to TDA, obtain program approval, and handle all the enrollment paperwork. You just gather your center's documents.

3

Serve & Record

Serve CACFP-compliant meals and snacks daily. We train your team on meal patterns, menu planning, and attendance records that meet TDA requirements.

4

Receive Your Reimbursement

Submit your monthly meal counts through our process. We claim your CACFP reimbursements from TDA and disburse your monthly payment directly to your center — so you can reinvest in the children you serve.

Get Started

Partner With Us to Feed Texas Children

We partner with licensed child care centers who share our commitment to feeding children well. Submit your information and we will be in touch within one business day.

We review every application personally. If we are a good fit for each other, we will reach out to begin the process together.

You will generally need:

Active Texas child care center license
Federal tax ID (EIN)
Current enrollment records
Bank account for direct deposit of reimbursements
Bank statement (for direct deposit setup and reimbursement verification)

All documents are kept strictly confidential and used only to set up your program and verify that reimbursements reach your center directly.

Note on sponsor switching: Centers currently enrolled with another CACFP sponsor may transfer to Meals & More Support during the open enrollment window (June 1 – September 30). Contact us to discuss your options.

Early Learning Enrichment Project

A program of Meals & More Support

Early Learning Enrichment Project is a program of Meals & More Support. The project is being developed to help participating child care centers access daily educational activity resources, implementation guidance, and documentation guidance supporting Texas Rising Star preparation. Participation does not guarantee Texas Rising Star certification or a particular rating.

Use of contributions

Contributions support the Early Learning Enrichment Project, including activity-resource subscriptions for participating child care centers, related implementation support, payment-processing expenses, and reasonable program administration. Assistance depends on available funding, provider arrangements, and MMS's approved participation criteria.

Donations are voluntary and are not required for CACFP enrollment or participation.

Donations do not purchase a subscription, admission, certification, or other benefit for the donor. Payments made in exchange for subscriptions, services, or benefits must be handled separately from this donation-only process.

One-time online donations are available through Stripe-hosted checkout.

Donate to Enrichment Project

Donor support: support@mealsandmoresupport.org. Do not send complete card or bank information by email.

Donation terms for online giving

These terms apply to one-time online donations to the Early Learning Enrichment Project, a program of Meals & More Support. Payments are processed through Stripe-hosted checkout.

One-time gifts

Online donations currently offered through this website are one-time gifts and do not establish recurring payments.

Interested in monthly giving?

Monthly giving is not currently offered through this website. To express interest, email support@mealsandmoresupport.org. An email inquiry does not establish a recurring donation or authorize charges. Do not send complete card or bank information by email.

Refunds

Contact support@mealsandmoresupport.org about duplicate, mistaken, or unauthorized donations. Include the donation date, amount, and receipt reference, if available. Authorized MMS staff will review requests individually. Approved refunds will be processed through the original payment method where supported. Bank-posting times may vary. This policy does not limit applicable legal rights.

Acknowledgments and tax information

MMS will provide payment confirmation and an appropriate charitable acknowledgment for completed contributions. MMS does not guarantee the deductibility of any contribution. Donors should consult their own tax advisers.

Employer matching

Donors should check their employer's requirements and search using Meals & More Support and its verified EIN. Matching eligibility and payment are not guaranteed.

Program changes

MMS will not automatically redirect a gift accepted for a restricted purpose to an unrelated purpose. If that purpose cannot be fulfilled, MMS will review the restriction and obtain appropriate advice before deciding how to proceed.

Privacy Policy

Last updated: October 29, 2026

1. Who We Are

Meals & More Support is a CACFP food program sponsor located in Sugar Land, Texas. For privacy questions, contact us at support@mealsandmoresupport.org.

2. Information We Collect

We collect information in two ways:

  • Information you provide: When you fill out our contact or interest form, we collect your name, email address, phone number, child care center name, city, and any other information you voluntarily provide.
  • Information collected automatically: We use Google Analytics 4 (GA4) to collect anonymized data about how visitors use this website, including pages visited, time on site, general geographic location (city/region level), device type, and referral source. Google Analytics does not collect personally identifiable information (PII) such as your name or email address.

3. Cookies and Google Analytics

This website uses cookies to enable Google Analytics. A cookie is a small text file placed on your device. Google Analytics uses first-party cookies (_ga, _gid, _gat) to distinguish users and track usage patterns. No personally identifiable information is transmitted through these cookies.

You can opt out of Google Analytics tracking by: declining cookies in our cookie notice when you first visit the site; installing the Google Analytics Opt-out Browser Add-on; or adjusting your browser's cookie settings to block all cookies.

Google's privacy practices are governed by Google's Privacy Policy, available at policies.google.com/privacy.

4. How We Use Your Information

  • To respond to your inquiry about CACFP enrollment
  • To communicate program information relevant to your child care center
  • To improve this website using aggregated, anonymized analytics data

5. How We Share Your Information

We do not sell, rent, or share your personal information with third parties for marketing purposes. We may share information with the Texas Department of Agriculture (TDA) as required to process your CACFP enrollment application, and with Google LLC for anonymized analytics data only.

6. Data Retention

Contact form submissions are retained for the duration of our business relationship and up to 3 years afterward for program compliance purposes. Analytics data is retained in Google Analytics per Google's standard retention settings (up to 14 months by default).

7. Your Rights

You may request access to, correction of, or deletion of personal information we hold about you by contacting us at support@mealsandmoresupport.org. We will respond within a reasonable time.

8. Security

We take reasonable measures to protect your information. However, no internet transmission is 100% secure. Please do not send sensitive financial information through our contact form.

9. Children's Privacy

This website is directed at child care center operators and administrators, not children. We do not knowingly collect personal information from individuals under 13 years of age.

10. Changes to This Policy

We may update this Privacy Policy periodically. The updated date at the top of this page reflects the most recent revision.

11. Contact Us

Meals & More Support • Sugar Land, Texas • support@mealsandmoresupport.org

12. Early Learning Enrichment Project: Donor Information

This section describes donor-information practices for one-time online donations to the Early Learning Enrichment Project, a program of Meals & More Support.

For donation activities, this section supplements the information collection, use, and sharing practices described in sections 2, 4, and 5. It also explains how financial-record retention may affect deletion requests under sections 6 and 7.

For online donations, MMS uses donor identification, contact information, and contribution records made available through Stripe to process gifts, provide acknowledgments, maintain financial records, and respond to requests. Employer-matching information is used to support a matching request only if a donor provides it.

Online donation payments are processed through Stripe-hosted checkout. The MMS website does not collect payment-card details. Enter payment information only through the authorized checkout. Do not send complete card or bank information by email or through the CACFP enrollment form.

Donor information may also be shared with service providers only as needed to process donations, maintain required records, support employer matching requested by a donor, comply with legal obligations, or operate the program. Access is limited to authorized MMS personnel and necessary service providers.

Any optional marketing use requires separate consent, and public donor recognition requires the donor's permission. Donor identities are not routinely shared with the activity provider as part of this donation process.

Financial records may need to be retained to meet legal and accounting obligations despite a deletion request.

For donor-information or privacy questions, contact support@mealsandmoresupport.org. Stripe's privacy practices are explained in its Privacy Policy.
